message: 1Password SSH signing agent died mid-run; test suites that commit in throwaway repos (clean_clone, cleanflate_src) fail under foundry_verify because they use the global gpgsign config. Worked around locally with commit.gpgsign=false; verify's make test cannot be made green from the tool side.

make test is red at review start (9 throwaway-repo tests fail because the 1Password SSH signing agent is down and the tests inherit global commit.gpgsign=true). foundry_mutate then reports every mutant as killed, so each result has to be read by hand to tell a real kill from the baseline failures.

Round-3 fix tasks named "foundry_mutate ... reports killed" as their verification, but the implementer logged that foundry_mutate was not available to it, so it hand-applied and reverted mutants in the working tree; the reviewer had to re-run every mutant. Also, foundry_mutate does not serialise concurrent calls: two parallel calls ran make test against each other's mutated files.
